## Rule

Input/output are fixed 10x10 active grids inside the NeuroGolf 30x30 canvas (`corpus.build(397, 200000)` min=max `[10,10]`). For every full non-background 2x2 block, count the number of distinct colors in that 2x2 block (`k` in 1..4). Paint color 3 in the two columns directly below that block for the next `k` rows, clipped to the active canvas. The generator leaves these shadow cells background; the staged rewrite overlays color 3 onto the original input.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
out = input.copy()
for r in range(9):
    for c in range(9):
        block = input[r:r+2, c:c+2]
        if np.all(block != 0):
            k = len(set(block.ravel()))
            out[r+2:min(10, r+2+k), c:c+2] = 3
```

Empirical corpus (`corpus.build(397, 200000)`): active grid always 10×10; full non-bg 2×2 blocks exactly 2 or 3/input; shadow cells min 4 / **max 22** / mean 11.6 across up to 3 variable-position rectangles; every diff is exactly bg(0)→color3. The output `[1,10,30,30]` is FREE, but every terminal op that carries this data-dependent 2D shadow is forced above 800: **(a)** broadcast `Where`/`Equal`/`OneHot` needs a full-plane `[1,1,30,30]` condition/index = **900 B** (smallest legal dtype BOOL/INT8 is still 900 elems; ORT strict shape-inference REJECTS a compact `[1,1,10,10]` cond vs `[1,10,30,30]` — "Incompatible dimensions" — so the plane cannot be cropped and re-broadcast); **(b)** `ScatterND`-to-output (the #139 mask-free lever) needs a static `[2·cells_max, 4]` INT64 index = **1408 B** (44 edits = clear ch0 + set ch3 per cell; INT32 rejected by ScatterND shape-inference; channel is axis 1 so no cheaper channel-vector index — a channel-last `[1,30,30,10]` transpose costs 36,000 B); **(c)** a memory-0 fused Conv/Einsum is **impossible** (rule is nonlinear: distinct-color-count threshold + variable-length k-row run; fails the #65 per-cell-map test). #139 wins on task371 (594) only because that edits a FIXED 5-cell template around ONE anchor — task397's 22-cell/3-rectangle shadow has no fixed template. Floor = min(900, 1408) = **900 B > 800**. Independently reproduced by 3 agents + a scored minimal `Where` graph (memory=900) and ScatterND probes (N·32 B: 256/512/768/1536 at N=8/16/24/48). No sub-800 graph exists; the staged 2636 rung stands (nothing staged).

## Current floor / blockers

The full `shadow30` condition is still charged at 900B because the terminal `Where(shadow30, color3, input)` must see a condition broadcastable to the full `[1,10,30,30]` output. A prefix/suffix row-run render can make a compact 10x10 run mask, but padding/broadcasting it before `Where` reintroduces the 900B condition and adds vector-scatter/comparison overhead.
